profile.name: 滨松科学相机
profile.description: 这是一台滨松科学相机，用于实验中的高灵敏图像采集。它支持曝光时间、触发方式、采集模式以及子区域/分区读出设置，适合显微成像、光学测量和其他需要同步触发与快速连续采集的实验。
profile.description_en: This is a Hamamatsu scientific camera used for sensitive image acquisition in laboratory experiments. It supports exposure control, trigger configuration, acquisition modes, and subarray/ROI readout, making it suitable for microscopy, optical measurements, and other experiments requiring synchronized triggering and rapid image capture.

registry.name: Hamamatsu Photonics Hamamatsu Hardware
registry.description: Hamamatsu Hardware是由Hamamatsu Photonics生产的表征设备，主要功能包括设备连接、设置、读取数据。支持Signal, Slot, updateCameraSettings等操作。
